rationale: Revision 2 meets my substantive conditions: exact obligations and evidence reporting precede synthesis; solver claims remain relative to the encoding; optional authority, consumable receipts and persistent liabilities are distinct; runtime and ledger acceptance remain authoritative; synthesis cannot alter specifications or introduce effects; financial delivery, existing MC/SP identities, PCD and correspondence obligations remain intact; and Pel requires verification and independent review of the exact candidate. Minimal evaluator replay is correctly an A1 prerequisite. The revision 2 hash was verified. This is endorsement of an advisory design and delivery plan, not confirmation of implementation or a Council/release acceptance receipt.
retained_caveats: The resource diagnostic increment needs reviewed operation signatures covering aliases, borrowing, branch alternatives, failure, successor handles and escape. Persistent debt must survive partial payment; consuming a local handle must never imply discharge of the financial obligation.

Continuation, split, migration and recovery must retain existing cumulative work, remaining authority and closure-reserve obligations. Preserving those existing gates is substantive; the diagnostic subset does not implement private composition or distributed uniqueness.

A1 fixture success and mutation detection qualify only a functional pilot. They cannot establish encoding adequacy, source/Core/K correspondence or a ledger theorem. Dead-branch division may be an explicitly unsupported fixture until the reviewed fragment actually includes division; its presence in the corpus cannot silently expand the fragment.

The AEO requirement families must become actual EARS statements with positive and negative OpenSpec scenarios before an implementation brief is approved. This candidate proposes that work; it does not already supply executable acceptance evidence.

The reported baseline corrections, including regression counts and the fixed Preview loan exit, were not independently re-executed by this adviser. Final documentation should bind each to its exact retained source and avoid generalizing across historical attempts.

At most one active implementation item and a named capacity allocation must actually preserve eligible financial delivery. If capacity is absent, these enhancements remain queued rather than becoming a reason to postpone authenticated lifecycle or mandatory proof work.
changes_of_position: I accept moving resource-use implementation and richer counterexample presentation to NEXT. Revision 2 keeps minimal replay in A1 and reviewed resource signatures as a prerequisite, preserving the necessary validation order.

I accept making restricted synthesis conditional later rather than unconditional NEXT. A frozen comparative corpus and preserved financial-delivery capacity provide a stronger justification for spending implementation effort.

I accept excluding an external Aeon proposer from the selected architecture rather than merely deferring it. The explicit scope-amendment route preserves reconsideration if measured need later warrants the translation burden.
I accept the smaller initial arithmetic fragment and delayed multiplication/division. Exact semantics and supported-coverage reporting matter more than matching Aeon feature breadth.
